shortDescription: Module for setup of AlertConfig Avi RESTful Object

options.name: action_group_ref
options.description: The alert config will trigger the selected alert action, which can send notifications and execute a controlscript. It is a reference to an object of type actiongroupconfig.

options.name: alert_rule
options.description: List of filters matching on events or client logs used for triggering alerts.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: autoscale_alert
options.description: This alert config applies to auto scale alerts.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: category
options.description: Determines whether an alert is raised immediately when event occurs (realtime) or after specified number of events occurs within rolling time window. Enum options - REALTIME, ROLLINGWINDOW, WATERMARK. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as REALTIME.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: A custom description field.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable or disable this alert config from generating new alerts. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: expiry_time
options.description: An alert is expired and deleted after the expiry time has elapsed. The original event triggering the alert remains in the event's log. Allowed values are 1-31536000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 86400.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the alert configuration.

options.name: obj_uuid
options.description: Uuid of the resource for which alert was raised.

options.name: object_type
options.description: The object type to which the alert config is associated with. Valid object types are - virtual service, pool, service engine. Enum options - VIRTUALSERVICE, POOL, HEALTHMONITOR, NETWORKPROFILE, APPLICATIONPROFILE, HTTPPOLICYSET, DNSPOLICY, SECURITYPOLICY, IPADDRGROUP, STRINGGROUP, SSLPROFILE, SSLKEYANDCERTIFICATE, NETWORKSECURITYPOLICY, APPLICATIONPERSISTENCEPROFILE, ANALYTICSPROFILE, VSDATASCRIPTSET, TENANT, PKIPROFILE, AUTHPROFILE, CLOUD, SERVERAUTOSCALEPOLICY, AUTOSCALELAUNCHCONFIG, MICROSERV

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: recommendation
options.description: Recommendation of alertconfig.

options.name: rolling_window
options.description: Only if the number of events is reached or exceeded within the time window will an alert be generated. Allowed values are 1-31536000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: source
options.description: Signifies system events or the type of client logsused in this alert configuration. Enum options - CONN_LOGS, APP_LOGS, EVENT_LOGS, METRICS.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: summary
options.description: Summary of reason why alert is generated.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: threshold
options.description: An alert is created only when the number of events meets or exceeds this number within the chosen time frame. Allowed values are 1-65536. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: throttle
options.description: Alerts are suppressed (throttled) for this duration of time since the last alert was raised for this alert config. Allowed values are 0-31536000. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 600.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.
